title: Improved Polish voivodeship and border question resolution
body:
ACCURATE VOIVODESHIP BORDER RESOLUTION
- Added canonical voivodeship name and inflection resolution covering all 16 Polish voivodeships.
- Questions referencing inflected forms (such as łódzkim, małopolskim, or śląskim), prefixes, or regional capitals (Łódź, Kraków, Katowice, Warszawa) now reliably match the correct voivodeship borders.
- Factual explanations clearly cite canonical voivodeship names when describing neighboring regions.
